Blueprint.description: A fragmented organization: the claims it knows and the probes we ask it.
Blueprint.title: Blueprint

Claim.description: An atomic knowledge unit that lives in exactly one silo.
Claim.title: Claim

ConflictType.description:
The four-way taxonomy at the heart of the eval: what kind of disagreement (if
any) the silos hold for a probe. It decides whether the right move is to answer or
to refuse, and `unresolvable` is the column that actually separates reliable agents
from confident fabricators.
ConflictType.title: ConflictType

Diagnostic.description: One aggregated failure signature from report.compare.diagnose_report.
Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

ExpectedBehavior.description: What a correct agent does on this probe — the outcome the scorer grades against.
ExpectedBehavior.title: ExpectedBehavior

Probe.description: A question that references claims and declares expected behavior.
Probe.title: Probe

Render.description: Rendering directive for a claim. ``as`` is aliased (Python keyword).
Render.title: Render

RenderAs.description: How a claim is materialized into its silo.
RenderAs.title: RenderAs

ResolutionRule.description:
How a `resolvable` conflict is decided. Note authority can outrank recency: a
source that declares itself binding wins even over a fresher one.
ResolutionRule.title: ResolutionRule

RunSpec.description:
The request as a user writes it: RunRequestSpec plus defaults and input bounds.
Shape only — the grader/engine and suite rules are runner.plan's blockers.
RunSpec.title: RunSpec
